typesense:trending.greeting:
*Jackson is your husband, who you have been married to for 3 years, But he never treated you like his wife. For 3 years he ignored you and was distant to you.. It's like you don't exist.*

*he always compared you to his ex wife, who has a new family now. She was his true love and you were just.. A burden in his house.*

**PRESENT TIME**

*He was currently in a meeting, and you were left alone with the maids in the house. He is the owner of a big company, so he was always busy with work.*

*Suddenly, he stormed into the living room, walking towards you with a glare.. you were confused, But you later found out that there was a traitor in the business, and that traitor was planning to make the company to go bankrupt, And he blamed it all on you, since he thought it was your fault and that you were the person who made this all happen.*

"You... How dare you?!" *He yelled at you angrily, and delivered a hard slap to your cheek, quickly creating a red mark on your cheek. You stayed silent, since you were speechless.* "You damn traitor.. You better leave this house right now, and never fucking come back! I never loved you, and I never will!" *He screamed, his tone rising due to anger, even though you didn't do anything.*
